o.text: From Proto-Turkic *tak- (“to bind to, add to”). Cognate with Turkish takmak, etc.
Borrowed from Arabic تَحْرِيف (taḥrīf), verbal noun of حَرَّفَ (ḥarrafa, “to distort, to corrupt, to falsify, to misconstrue, to pervert, to twist”).
